purpose: First bounded cognitive-theater discriminator. Compare native-face surface learning with leave-one-face-out cross-face reconstruction before adding richer semantic machinery.
split_rule: Each relation/face has two teaching surfaces and one held-out surface. Held-out surfaces use changed names/wording where applicable.

local_knowledge_fields.reporter: may possess a report about proposition P
local_knowledge_fields.receiver: receives that report but does not thereby possess independent truth of P
local_knowledge_fields.world: independently determines whether P is true

relations.expected_consequence: Do not promote P solely because a source reports P.

JAPANESE: context may omit already active participants without licensing invented truth
BRAZILIAN_PORTUGUESE: surface/register variation must not convert report into fact
MATHEMATICS: report predicate does not entail proposition

train: Mika reported that the door is open. Her report alone does not make the door open.
A report can be wrong. Check the world before treating the report as a fact.
heldout: Ken said the light is on, but his statement alone does not prove that the light is actually on.

train: ミカは「ドアが開いている」と報告した。報告したこと自体は、ドアが実際に開いていることを保証しない。
報告は間違うことがある。事実として扱う前に、外の状態を確かめる。
heldout: ケンは「明かりがついている」と言ったが、その発言だけでは実際についているとは限らない。

train: Mika relatou que a porta está aberta. O relato, por si só, não garante que a porta esteja realmente aberta.
Um relato pode estar errado. Verifique o mundo antes de tratar o relato como fato.
heldout: Ken disse que a luz está acesa, mas a fala dele, sozinha, não prova que a luz esteja realmente acesa.

train: Report_s(P) does not imply P: Report_s(P) ↛ P.
Let R_s(P)=1 mean source s reports P. R_s(P)=1 is insufficient to derive P.
heldout: Says_k(Q)=1 does not entail Q; the report predicate is not a truth predicate.

local_knowledge_fields.observer: may observe a shared terminal state without full histories

relations.expected_consequence: Do not identify histories merely because their endpoints coincide.

JAPANESE: temporal ordering must remain reconstructible despite shared endpoint
BRAZILIAN_PORTUGUESE: generative retelling must preserve path difference
MATHEMATICS: noninjective endpoint map does not imply equal preimages

train: Two routes can finish at the same place after different histories.
Path one goes through A then B and path two goes through C; the endpoint matches but the histories do not.
heldout: Two processes end in the same state, yet one passed through X and the other through Y, so their trajectories remain different.

train: 二つの経路は、異なる履歴を通って同じ場所に到着することがある。
一つの経路はAからBを通り、もう一つはCを通る。終点が同じでも履歴は同じではない。
heldout: 二つの過程が同じ状態で終わっても、一方はXを、他方はYを通ったなら、軌跡は異なる。

train: Duas rotas podem chegar ao mesmo lugar depois de histórias diferentes.
Um caminho passa por A e depois B; outro passa por C. O ponto final é igual, mas as histórias não são.
heldout: Dois processos terminam no mesmo estado, mas um passou por X e o outro por Y; as trajetórias continuam diferentes.

train: h1=(A,B,x), h2=(C,x), terminal(h1)=terminal(h2)=x, but h1≠h2.
f(h1)=f(h2)=x does not imply h1=h2 when f keeps only the endpoint.
heldout: End(π1)=End(π2) while π1≠π2; equality of terminal state does not imply equality of path.

local_knowledge_fields.learner: has evidence E that does not discriminate all live hypotheses
local_knowledge_fields.evidence_field: leaves at least two incompatible candidates open

relations.expected_consequence: WITHHOLD rather than invent a resolved answer.

JAPANESE: implicit context must not be filled with unsupported commitment
BRAZILIAN_PORTUGUESE: generative continuation may remain open rather than force closure
MATHEMATICS: non-derivability of H and not-H blocks truth-valued commitment

train: If the evidence cannot distinguish the two hypotheses, withhold instead of guessing.
Not enough evidence for either answer means keep both possibilities open.
heldout: When the observations support neither option strongly enough, do not pick one at random; withhold the conclusion.

train: 証拠だけでは二つの仮説を区別できないなら、推測せずに判断を保留する。
どちらの答えにも十分な証拠がないなら、両方の可能性を開いたままにする。
heldout: 観測からどちらも十分に支持できないときは、適当に一つを選ばず、結論を保留する。

train: Se as evidências não distinguem as duas hipóteses, suspenda a conclusão em vez de adivinhar.
Sem evidência suficiente para nenhuma resposta, mantenha as duas possibilidades em aberto.
heldout: Quando as observações não sustentam nenhuma opção o bastante, não escolha ao acaso; deixe a conclusão em aberto.

train: E ⊬ H and E ⊬ ¬H implies WITHHOLD.
If both H and ¬H remain compatible with E, decision(E)=WITHHOLD.
heldout: Models(E) contains cases satisfying H and cases satisfying ¬H; therefore no truth-valued commitment is licensed.

local_knowledge_fields.agent_B: does not know that agent_A knows P

temporal_sequence: B lacks the higher-order fact about A's knowledge
relations.expected_consequence: Preserve nested perspective rather than flattening all agents into one knowledge field.

JAPANESE: context and omitted arguments must preserve whose knowledge is indexed
BRAZILIAN_PORTUGUESE: pronoun/subject variation must preserve nested knower identity
MATHEMATICS: modal operator nesting and negation scope

train: Aiko knows that the key is in the box. Bruno does not know that Aiko knows this.
Lina knows P, while Omar lacks the information that Lina knows P.
heldout: Sara knows the code is correct, but Theo does not know that Sara knows it.

train: アイコは鍵が箱の中にあることを知っている。ブルーノは、アイコがそれを知っていることを知らない。
リナはPを知っているが、オマールはリナがPを知っていることを知らない。
heldout: サラはコードが正しいことを知っているが、テオはサラがそれを知っていることを知らない。

train: Aiko sabe que a chave está na caixa. Bruno não sabe que Aiko sabe disso.
Lina sabe P, mas Omar não sabe que Lina sabe P.
heldout: Sara sabe que o código está correto, mas Theo não sabe que Sara sabe disso.

train: K_A(P) ∧ ¬K_B(K_A(P)).
K_L(P)=1 and K_O(K_L(P))=0.

claim_fence: Teaching/held-out seed only. The relation labels and theater metadata are teacher scaffolding, not learner-owned semantics. No language competence, cultural cognition, mathematical understanding, or internalization claim follows from storing this file.
